means: Return to the screen or panel this one was opened from.
Go on to the next step of a multi-step flow, or forward again after going back.
Marks a row or tile that opens its own screen.
Jump to a page of the open document by its number.
Show the hidden part of this section or panel in place.
note: In a disclosure - a section that opens and closes in place - the control shows the action a click performs: a collapsed section shows nav.expand, an open one nav.collapse. There is no separate disclosure record.

means: Hide the part of this section or panel that is shown in place.
note: In a disclosure the open section shows this glyph, the action a click performs; see nav.expand.

means: This field opens a short list of choices.
Close this panel, dialog, search or window. Nothing is deleted, stopped or undone.
Open the menu of further actions for this item or screen.
Leave the application or a special mode, such as launcher mode, and hand the screen back.
shape: arrow leaving a box through its side

means: Open the item outside this screen - in a new window, another app or the browser.
shape: arrow leaving a square at its top corner
note: On Android the control opens the browser or another app, never a window, and takes the platform-qualified form 'Open in another app' / 'Открыть в другом приложении' / 'Відкрити в іншому застосунку'; a label that names the object - 'Open in browser', 'Open in FastMediaSorter' - qualifies that form (rule 3).

means: Scroll up by one screen.
Scroll down by one screen.
Jump the view to the top of a long page or list.
note: On a page the qualified names are 'В начало страницы' / 'На початок сторінки'.

means: Jump the view to the end of a long page or list.
note: On a page the qualified names are 'В конец страницы' / 'У кінець сторінки'.

means: Open the list of chapters or sections of this document.

ref.source: Material Icons 'toc' with its bullets moved to the left edge (Apache-2.0)

note: A book reader's Russian name is 'Оглавление', the declared form for a book's table of contents; elsewhere 'Содержание'.

means: Drag this handle to change the size of a tile or window.
Send the app, the player or a window out of the way into the background; it keeps running.
shape: a short bar at the bottom of the grid
note: The offset from the grid centre is the shape. Its Russian name is not 'Свернуть' - that is the name of nav.collapse. A window's minimise is this meaning, labelled 'Свернуть окно' / 'Згорнути вікно', never the bare 'Свернуть' / 'Згорнути' (rule 3).

means: Start playing or showing this item.
Pause playback; pressing play continues from the same place.
Names the toggle itself where a setting assigns it to a gesture or key. A live control shows play or pause instead.
Stop playback, recording or a broadcast; the next start begins from the beginning.
Go to the previous item of a sequence: file, track, page, chapter or search match.
shape: triangle pointing left against a bar
note: Declared mirrored form for document paging (ICON-RENDER rule 7, 2026-10-07): where this meaning steps to the previous page or chapter of a document - a book, a PDF, a comic, a reader's page link - a right-to-left layout shows this glyph flipped horizontally, because the previous page lies to the right. As transport - a file, a track, a slide, a search match - it never mirrors, which is why rtl stays fixed.

means: Go to the next item of a sequence: file, track, page, chapter or search match.
shape: triangle pointing right against a bar
note: Declared mirrored form for document paging (ICON-RENDER rule 7, 2026-10-07): where this meaning steps to the next page or chapter of a document - a book, a PDF, a comic, a reader's page link - a right-to-left layout shows this glyph flipped horizontally, because the next page lies to the left. As transport - a file, a track, a slide, a search match - it never mirrors, which is why rtl stays fixed.

means: Jump back inside the current item by a fixed time.
Jump forward inside the current item by a fixed time.
Go to the first page or chapter of the open document or book.
shape: chevron pointing left against a bar

means: Play or jump to a random item.
Play the whole list and start it again at the end.
Play the current item again and again.
shape: two arrows in a loop around the digit 1

means: Show the item over the whole screen.
Return from fullscreen to the normal layout.
Keep playing in a small floating window.
note: A floating panel that carries no video - StreamsPlayer's compact radio panel - is this meaning under the qualified label 'Compact panel' (rule 3); the label's forms in other languages are the product's own.

means: Leave the small floating player and return to the full window.
shape: a window with a title bar

means: Sound level, or make it louder.
Make the sound quieter.
Silence the sound.
note: Mute is a live transport control (ICON-RENDER rule 4): while sound plays it shows this glyph, captioned 'Mute', and while muted it shows media.volume, captioned 'Unmute' - the action, not the state.

means: Play faster or slower than normal.
Stop playback after a set time.
Show images one after another automatically.
note: A random slideshow is this glyph under the qualified label 'Random slideshow' / 'Случайное слайд-шоу' / 'Випадкове слайд-шоу' (rule 3). Its declared variant `random` - the same frame with the pips of a die inside, distinct from media.random - is owed: the exporter draws a variant only from a reference drawable.

means: Show this item on a TV or another screen (Chromecast).
shape: screen with radio waves in its corner

means: Show or choose subtitles.
shape: the letters CC in a box

means: Choose which sound track of a video plays.
sharedWhy: The track selector is about the sound of the item on screen; Material draws it with the same note.

means: Turn the picture dark while sound, broadcast or recording carry on.
Make the picture or the text larger.
note: A text size that reflows the text is action.text-larger; zoom scales what is shown.

means: Make the picture or the text smaller.
note: A text size that reflows the text is action.text-smaller; zoom scales what is shown.

means: Let the screen turn with the device.
The screen keeps its current orientation.
note: The reference draws a bare padlock, which is status.locked; a phone-with-padlock glyph is owed.

means: Show side-by-side stereo content as 3D.
Go to the last page or chapter of the open document or book.
shape: chevron pointing right against a bar
note: The counterpart of media.to-start.

means: Play the item in the VR player.
shape: VR goggles with a play triangle

glyph.source: Material Icons 'vrpano'-style goggles (the body of device.vr-headset) with a play triangle cut out, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

means: Start recording the stream that is playing into a file; while recording, the control shows the stop square of media.stop in the state error colour.

glyph.source: a solid dot, the red-dot convention, drawn for this contract

sharedWhy: The same red-dot convention; one records with the camera, the other records the stream that is playing.

means: Save the frame on screen as a picture file.

glyph.source: a solid dot inside a frame, drawn for this contract

note: Not 'photo_camera', which is feature.camera's picture.

means: Show items as tiles in rows and columns.
Show items one per line.
Show items as rows with named columns.
shape: a framed grid with a header row and a narrow first column

means: Show or hide the recognized text laid over a scanned page.
shape: lines of text in a frame
note: A toggle: on shows the layer. The off form is owed - the exporter draws states from the reference product's drawables only; until it exists a product shows the state as a pressed look and aria-pressed. action.extract-text recognizes the text; this shows what was recognized.

means: A display: this screen, a monitor or what is being shown on it.
Create a new item here.
Destroy the file or item, or move it to the trash where the source has one.
Take the item off this list, desktop, panel or taskbar. The file or app itself stays.
Empty a whole list, history or cache at once.
shape: trash can with lines beside it

means: Abandon the operation in progress or the edit, leaving everything as it was before.
Accept the choice and close.
Erase what is typed in this field.
sharedWhy: A cross inside a text field clears it on every platform; its place inside the field tells it apart from Close.

means: Make a copy of the item, or put text on the clipboard.
note: Its done state is a word, not a drawing: 'Copied' / 'Скопировано' / 'Скопійовано' beside the same glyph. The check mark is action.confirm and never stands for it.

means: Move the item to another folder or resource.
Change the name of the item.
Change the content or settings of the item.
Cut away the edges of an image.
Save the cropped part as a new file.
shape: corner brackets with a small check

means: Make a smaller copy of the file.
shape: arrows pointing inwards from the corners

means: Pack the chosen files into one archive file.
shape: box with a lid and a downward arrow

means: Turn the image by 90 degrees.
Mirror the image from left to right.
shape: two halves around a dashed line

means: Hand a copy to another app through the system share sheet.
Send the item to one of this app's own destinations - the watch, a printer, another resource.
Open the mail composer the device is configured with, to write a message.
Write data out to a file that can be kept or moved elsewhere.
Turn the document or file into another format, keeping the original.
shape: a square drawn by two crossing arrows
note: Qualified by its target: 'Convert to HTML' / 'Конвертировать в HTML'. A convert that replaces the original is action.convert-to-video.

means: Re-encode an animated picture (WEBP, APNG, GIF) as a video file and delete the original.
shape: a film frame with an arrow into it

means: Rewrite text typed in the wrong keyboard layout as if it had been typed in the other one.
shape: two key caps joined by a two-way arrow

means: Read data in from a file, a link or a code.
Fetch from the internet or a cloud to this device.
Add an app or a browser extension to this device from a store.
Send from this device to a cloud or server.
Write the edit to storage.
Take back the last change.
shape: arrow curving back to the left

means: Apply again the change that was undone.
shape: arrow curving forward to the right

means: Return settings to the values the app shipped with.
Load the current state again.
Run the same attempt again after it failed, expecting a different outcome.
shape: a circular arrow re-entering a ring at its top left (the everyday retry/again picture)

means: Restore the lost connection or access to a resource.
Bring two copies up to date with each other.
shape: two arrows chasing in a circle

means: Check that the server answers with the entered settings.
shape: arcs of a signal with a gauge needle

means: Find items or text by typing.
Look through a place for items and list what was found.
shape: magnifier beside lines of a list

means: Find text and replace it with other text.
note: Below 24 px the reference reads as action.sync; the magnifier must stay visible.

means: Make the reading text smaller; the text reflows.
Make the reading text larger; the text reflows.
Show only the items that match the chosen conditions.
Show all items again.
Fine-tune values such as levels, balance or camera parameters.
Change the order of the items.
Mark every item.
Clear every mark.
Bookmark the item; an outlined star means it is not a favorite yet.
Keep the item at the top or on the taskbar; an outlined pin means it is not pinned.
Hold and drag this handle to move the item within the list.
Move the item one place up.
Move the item one place down.
Move the item to the first place of the list.
sharedWhy: Both mean 'to the top edge'; an item's own menu moves the item, a list's toolbar moves the view.

means: Move the item to the last place of the list.
sharedWhy: Both mean 'to the bottom edge'; an item's own menu moves the item, a list's toolbar moves the view.

means: Start a task, program or scenario now.
sharedWhy: Start-now is drawn as play on every desktop and mobile platform.

means: Send the item to a printer.
Translate text into another language.
shape: two script letters side by side

means: Recognize the text in an image so it can be copied or translated.
Speak the text with the device voice.
Read a QR code or barcode with the camera.
Exchange the two sides, such as source and target language.
Make a new folder here.
Make a new text note.
Read every file back and confirm it is intact.
shape: sheet with lines and a check mark

means: Rebuild a drive's partition table and file system so it can be used again.
Find the files whose content is the same.
Compare two folders or files and show what differs.
shape: two sheets, one with a plus and a minus

means: Write test data into all the free space of a drive or folder.
shape: tipped paint bucket with a drop

glyph.source: Material Icons 'format_color_fill' without its colour bar, moved 3 units down to centre it (Apache-2.0)

means: Overwrite the file's content and then delete it, so it cannot be recovered.
Seal a file into a secret container that only its owner can open.
Take the original file back out of a secret container.
Set a running measurement (a distance, a step count) back to zero.
Discard the edits not yet saved and return to the last saved state.
shape: sheet with a circular arrow pointing back

means: Choose the size and the typeface in which text is shown.
shape: a small and a large capital T
note: action.text-smaller and action.text-larger change the size only; the typeface is this meaning's.

means: Put the clipboard's contents into the field or the place the control belongs to.
Copy the selection to the clipboard and remove it from where it was.
Invert the upper and lower case of the selection (the CapsLock fix).
shape: a capital A beside a small a

glyph.source: a capital A beside a small a, drawn for this contract

means: Attach a disk container or image as a drive letter.
shape: arrow entering a drive from above

glyph.source: a drive body with an arrow entering it from above, drawn for this contract

means: Make a new virtual disk, a .fdd container.
shape: the content.disk-container sheet with a plus

glyph.source: Material Icons 'insert_drive_file' with the drive of content.disk-container and a plus, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

means: Give the unused space inside a container file back to the drive it is on.
shape: two arrows pressing toward each other

means: Mount a container by itself when the user signs in.
Copy a partition disk, byte for byte, into a new container file.
shape: the segmented bar with an arrow leaving it toward a sheet

glyph.source: the segmented bar of content.partition-disk with an arrow into a sheet, drawn for this contract after Material Icons 'move_down' (Apache-2.0)

means: Detach a mounted drive; the container keeps its data.
shape: triangle pointing up above a bar

means: Make a container's disk larger.
shape: two arrows pointing away from each other along the diagonal

means: Erase a volume and leave it empty.
Write a copy that is read-only for good.

glyph.source: Material Icons 'edit' struck through, drawn for this contract after 'edit_off' (Apache-2.0)

means: Replace the password of a protected container.
Add a container to the list under a short name.
shape: list of lines with a plus

means: Show or hide the characters of a secret the user types or has typed.
note: A toggle (ICON-RENDER rule 4): the glyph shows the state. Its off form is the struck-through eye of source.hidden, named 'Hide password' / 'Скрыть пароль' / 'Сховати пароль'. The off form's own file is owed: the exporter draws a state only from a reference drawable.

means: Display a code on this screen for another device to scan.
shape: QR code without the camera brackets
note: The reason it cannot borrow action.scan-code: that reads a code with the camera.

means: Open the picker in which the user chooses a file.
shape: sheet with a folded corner and three dots

glyph.source: Material Icons 'insert_drive_file' with three dots cut out, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

note: The '..' that tells the user a dialog follows belongs to the label ('Choose file..'), not to the name.

means: Open the picker in which the user chooses a folder.

glyph.source: Material Icons 'folder' with three dots cut out, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

note: The '..' that tells the user a dialog follows belongs to the label ('Choose folder..'), not to the name.

means: Put a shortcut to a command or a file on the desktop, the Start menu or the taskbar.
shape: the insert_drive_file sheet with a shortcut arrow (a bent band with a triangular head) cut out of its body

glyph.source: Material Icons 'insert_drive_file' with the shortcut arrow cut out, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

means: Leave out the step that is running or offered and go on without it.
shape: a short dash, then an arc that hops over a bar and ends in a right-pointing arrowhead - an arrow leaping the thing it skips

means: Stop the operating system from offering to play content when a device is plugged in.
shape: a play triangle crossed out by a long slash - Material Icons 'play_disabled'

means: Overwrite an existing item with the incoming one; the item that was there is gone.
shape: outlined bar above a filled bar with an arrow pointing down between them

glyph.source: FastMediaSorter for Windows (FMS_W), drawn for this contract

means: Bring an item the user hid back into the lists it was hidden from.
sharedWhy: The same eye as action.reveal: both read 'shown'. One shows the characters of a secret, the other brings a hidden list item back; the label and the place tell the control apart, and the struck-through eye of source.hidden is the hidden form of both.

means: Bring one more device of the person into the exchange by enrolling it on their account, with the password, a pairing code or a connection string (DEVICE-EXCHANGE section 5).
shape: a phone outline with a plus beside it

glyph.source: drawn for this contract: a phone after Material Icons 'smartphone' and a plus after 'add' (Apache-2.0)

note: DEVICE-EXCHANGE 25 item CW fixes no word for this action; the names are the reference product's 'Connect watch' / 'Подключить часы' without its object, and a label may name the device it connects (rule 3). 'Подключить' alone is action.mount-disk.

name.en: Get the clipboard from the server

means: Read the person's clipboard on the exchange server onto this device (DEVICE-EXCHANGE section 22).
shape: a solid clipboard with a down arrow cut out of it

glyph.source: Material Icons 'assignment' moved one unit down, with an arrow cut out, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

note: The wording rule of action.send-clipboard holds here: «буфер», never «буфер обмена» / «буфер обміну».

name.en: Send the clipboard to the server

means: Put what is on this device's clipboard into the person's clipboard on the exchange server, for their other devices to read (DEVICE-EXCHANGE section 22).
shape: a solid clipboard with an up arrow cut out of it

glyph.source: Material Icons 'assignment' moved one unit down, with an arrow cut out, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

note: In Russian and Ukrainian the thing is «буфер», never «буфер обмена» / «буфер обміну», which is the word of the exchange server alone (DEVICE-EXCHANGE 25 item CW); the device's own system clipboard keeps the system's name.

means: The free-hand tool of a drawing editor: lay a stroke where the finger or the pointer moves.
shape: brush: a slanted handle and a rounded, filled bristle tip, never a pencil's sharpened point
note: Split from the drawing editor on 2026-10-07: entering the editor is feature.drawing, and this record is the tool inside it, beside tool.eraser, tool.rectangle, tool.oval and tool.text. At 16 to 20 px it must not read as a pencil, the shape of action.edit and action.rename: a product's drawing keeps the rounded tip apart from the handle and draws no point. A first drawing; the first product to ship the brush in a file of its own may replace it if the file keeps the shape.

means: Draw a rectangle.
note: The filled figure is the declared variant `filled`, labelled 'Filled rectangle' / 'Залитый прямоугольник' / 'Залитий прямокутник'; this record keeps the outline. The variant's drawing is owed: the exporter draws a variant only from a reference drawable.

means: Draw an oval.
note: The filled figure is the declared variant `filled`, labelled 'Filled oval' / 'Залитый овал' / 'Залитий овал'; this record keeps the outline. The variant's drawing is owed: the exporter draws a variant only from a reference drawable.

means: Place text on the image.
Erase part of the drawing.
A real directory on a disk or server.
A picture or photo.
note: A missing or broken image inside a document the user opened - a book, a PDF, a comic, a converted document - shows this glyph with the source's alt text where the source gives one: a document's own pictures are local user content, not downloaded pictures (ICON-EXTERNAL rules 3 and 4, 2026-10-07).

means: A video file or video stream.
A music or sound file.
A text, PDF or other readable document.
shape: sheet with lines and a folded corner

means: A book or long text being read, and its reading settings.
An ordered list of tracks.
An animated GIF image.
A live internet radio or TV stream received by the app.
shape: television with an antenna and a play mark

means: A map.
A contact, or the account the app is signed in with.
A text message.
A phone call.
Installed apps and programs.
What happened before: recent items, logs, sessions.
shape: clock with an arrow turning back

means: Values drawn over time.
A time of day, or something set to happen at a time.
A file sealed into a secret container (FDSEC-FORMAT); every product that shows the file type shows this.
shape: sheet with a folded corner and a padlock cut out of it

glyph.source: Material Icons 'insert_drive_file' with a padlock drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

means: A file that becomes a drive when it is mounted, and stays readable without one (FDD-FORMAT); every product that shows the file type shows this.
shape: sheet with a folded corner and a drive cut out of it, its light left standing

glyph.source: Material Icons 'insert_drive_file' with a drive drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

means: A virtual disk whose container fills a partition of a physical disk, not a file.
shape: the content.disk-container sheet drawn inside a horizontal bar cut into segments, one segment filled

means: Unallocated space on a physical disk that a new partition disk may use.
shape: the segmented bar with one hatched, empty segment

means: The text of a song.
shape: a music note beside three lines of text

glyph.svg: <g transform="translate(-2.8 1.6) scale(.8)"><path d="M12 3v10.55c-.59-.34-1.27-.55-2-.55-2.21 0-4 1.79-4 4s1.79 4 4 4 4-1.79 4-4V7h4V3h-6z" fill="currentColor"/></g><path d="M13 5h8v2h-8zM13 10h8v2h-8zM13 15h8v2h-8z" fill="currentColor"/>
glyph.source: Material Icons 'music_note' beside three lines of text, drawn for this contract (Apache-2.0)

means: A short local text or checklist note.
shape: sticky note with a folded corner and lines

means: A note made of items that are ticked off.
A guest account: a person who receives what a member granted to them and publishes nothing of their own (DEVICE-EXCHANGE section 19, item AO).
shape: head and shoulders drawn as a hollow outline
note: Against the solid head and shoulders of content.person the outline is the whole difference, as between Material 'person' and 'person_outline'; the label and the place tell the control apart. The wire values 'member' and 'guest' are never shown (DEVICE-EXCHANGE 25 item CV).

means: The offer, one-time or shared, that lets one more person register an account on the exchange server (DEVICE-EXCHANGE section 19).
shape: a ticket with a notch on each side and a perforation of three squares

glyph.source: a ticket drawn for this contract after Material Icons 'confirmation_number' (Apache-2.0)

note: A link with a password to one folder is not an invitation and creates no account (DEVICE-EXCHANGE 25 item CW). The kind of an invitation, 'own device or family' or 'guest', is a label and not a second glyph.

means: An entry on the main screen that points to a place with files.
shape: stack of media with a play mark

means: A folder on this device.
sharedWhy: A local folder lives on this phone; the phone is its mark. The two drawings must become one.
note: On a desktop computer a local folder lives on that computer, not on a phone: the declared variant desktop, a folder beside a monitor, is this meaning's form there (2026-10-07). It is a drawing of its own and never the monitor of view.screen alone - one picture, one meaning. The variant's drawing is owed: the exporter draws a variant only from a reference drawable.

means: A memory card or USB drive.
A shared folder on a computer in the home network (SMB).
note: The reference draws a plain folder, which is content.folder; a folder with a network mark is owed.

means: A folder on an FTP server.
A folder on a secure SFTP server.
Files kept in an online storage such as Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive.
sharedWhy: Weather glyphs are literal pictures of the sky and only ever appear inside a weather surface.

means: The virtual resource that collects every favorite.
sharedWhy: The resource is the set of starred items; one concept, one star.

means: The virtual resource of recently opened items.
shape: clock with an arrow turning back
sharedWhy: Recent items are history; the clock face alone means time.

means: The photos taken with the camera of this device.
The paired Wear OS watch.
A filter or a place: the items the user added or imported themselves, as opposed to those a shared catalog supplied.
shape: head and shoulders with a plus
note: A product may qualify 'channels' with its own noun (rule 3).

means: The list of items the user hid, from where they can be shown again.
sharedWhy: The off form of action.reveal - the characters are hidden - is drawn with this glyph: both say 'not shown'; the label tells the control from the place.

means: The server through which the user's own devices exchange channels and live broadcasts.
shape: two stacked server bays, each with an indicator dot

means: Works, granted or verified.
shape: check mark in a filled circle
note: A run verdict of CLI-EVENT-STREAM shows this glyph beside the verdict word (Passed, Done; Failed). The word names the run's result, not this meaning, so it does not substitute for the name: the glyph there is decoration of the word and carries no accessible name of its own (ICON-RENDER rule 8 is met by the word).

means: Something failed and needs attention.
note: A run verdict of CLI-EVENT-STREAM shows this glyph beside the verdict word (Passed, Done; Failed). The word names the run's result, not this meaning, so it does not substitute for the name: the glyph there is decoration of the word and carries no accessible name of its own (ICON-RENDER rule 8 is met by the word).

means: Works, but with a risk the user should know about.
note: Active since 2026-10-02: FastMediaSorter_Lite's secure-container placeholder is the first product to ship it. The day tone of its hue is #EF6C00 (ICON-RENDER 0.14).

means: No result yet: never played, never checked, not granted yet.
Protected or blocked: a PIN, a VPN, a permission that was refused.
The run was stopped by the user before it ended - not a failure.
shape: square cut out of a filled circle

means: The run ended but its result could not be judged either way.
Open the settings of the app or of this part of it.
Show details about this item or about the app.
note: Where it opens the details of the app itself, the label may read 'About <product>' ('О программе', 'Про програму', 'Über', 'À propos') - the qualified form of this meaning for the app; it is never a separate glyph.

means: Explain what this option does.
The mark of the product showing it.
note: The drawing and the names are FastMediaSorter's. Another product shows its own mark under its own name in the same places; that mark is identity artwork (section 7) and is never drawn with this glyph.

means: Dark colours for the app or the reader.
Choose the colour scheme the interface and the text are shown in.
note: Its choices are named, not drawn: a product lists its themes as words beside the one glyph - for a reader Light / Светлая / Світла, Sepia / Сепия / Сепія, Dark / Тёмная / Темна, Night / Ночная / Нічна. The moon of app.night-mode never stands for a dark theme. A light / dark switch shows this glyph under the qualified label 'Switch theme' / 'Сменить тему' / 'Змінити тему' (rule 3); there is no separate theme-toggle record.

means: Choose the language the interface is shown in.
shape: a globe with a speech mark

means: Choose a colour.
The accessibility service and its options.
Tools for testing and diagnosing the app.
Swipes and taps that trigger actions.
Operations that run on their own at set times.
Type a command for the product's own command-line tool and see its output.
The app's global key combinations.

glyph.source: two key caps joined by a plus, drawn for this contract

means: One overview of every key combination the app owns, with its state.
shape: one key cap above rows of text

glyph.source: one key cap above rows of text, drawn for this contract

means: Ask the publisher's release feed whether a newer version of this app exists, and report; nothing is downloaded or installed by it.
shape: a clock face with a circular arrow around it

means: Wireless network.
Cellular data.
Cable network.
No network connection.
The internet at large.
The keyboard layouts installed in the operating system and how to switch between them.

note: Not feature.launcher, which replaces the home screen. An absorbed sibling product's mark may stand at this feature's entry points as identity artwork, declared in the absorbing product's registry row (rule 7); its tab, menu, tile and settings-row glyph stays this one.

means: Draw by hand over the image: open the drawing editor with its tools.
shape: a free-hand line that loops back on itself
note: Split from tool.brush on 2026-10-07: this record is the editor and the act of drawing, tool.brush the tool inside it. Never a pencil, which is action.edit, never the palette of app.colour, and never the hand of app.gestures, although Material names this drawing 'gesture'. A first drawing; the first product to ship the record may replace it with a file of its own that keeps the shape.

means: A palette of special characters - the ones a keyboard layout does not type directly - from which one is copied.

glyph.source: capital Omega, drawn for this contract

means: The app's own menu that opens beside the selected text, with the actions for it: copy, cut, paste, layout conversion, case, translation and quick launch.
shape: a highlighted line of text with a menu panel of rows below it

glyph.source: a highlighted line of text with a menu panel below it, drawn for this contract

note: Asked by CyrFlip on 2026-10-11 for its settings destination of the same name (the tab drew its caption alone until then, S0062 D7). The panel of rows is what keeps it apart from the solid highlight line above it; rows alone would be view.list, a highlighted line alone would be nothing in the vocabulary.

means: The exchange server takes one live stream from a broadcaster and hands it to every listener, in place of the listeners reaching the broadcasting device at its own address (the relay of DEVICE-EXCHANGE 7.6).
shape: the dot and radio arcs of feature.live-broadcast over one server bay with an indicator dot

glyph.source: drawn for this contract: the arcs of feature.live-broadcast over a server bay after Material Icons 'dns' (Apache-2.0)

note: Names the relay and nothing else (DEVICE-EXCHANGE 25 item CW): not a tunnel to a folder, not a packet on Drive, not the giving out of a ready film. The Russian and Ukrainian names are the contract's words; the loanword «релей» is not used.
